title: Skyblock Portals
description: Adds buildable portals to skyblock versions of overworld and nether dimensions using somewhat difficult to obtain vanilla items, requiring players to progress to a certain degree in order to obtain access to these dimensions.
body:
# Skyblock Dimensions

**Master the Overworld and Nether to unlock their skyblock counterparts!**

This Fabric mod adds portals that transport players to skyblock versions of the overworld and nether dimensions. The dimensions are a 1:1 mirror of the originals. 

## Features

- **Overworld Skyblock**: the perfect place for building without having to dig a huge perimeter
- **Nether Skyblock**: tired of spawn proofing a huge area just to make your mob farm faster? you've come to the right place!
- **Vanilla-friendly mechanics** - no custom blocks or items required

## Portal Recipes

### Overworld Skyblock Portal
- **Frame**: Dark Prismarine
- **Activation Item**: Recovery Compass  

### Nether Skyblock Portal  
- **Frame**: Crying Obsidian
- **Activation Item**: Nether Star  

## Why These Materials?

- **Dark Prismarine**: Requires players to find and engage with an Ocean Monument
- **Recovery Compass**: Requires players to find and loot an Ancient City
- **Crying Obsidian**: Requires players to explore many ruined portals or barter with Piglins
- **Nether Star**: Requires players to slay a Wither after collecting 3 Wither Skeleton Skulls

Perfect for SMP servers wanting progression-gated skyblock islands without custom content!

## Installation

The mod is required on both Server and Clients due to custom colored versions of the portal panels, particles and networking.

This mod uses [customportalapi](https://github.com/kyrptonaught/customportalapi) made by [kyrptonaught](https://github.com/kyrptonaught)
